title: Kamishiro Rui — A Greeting In Return〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Phew...
That should be it for the shops I planned on visiting today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I managed to get everything I needed for running maintenance, so I'll head home and...

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
Hey, check out that screen!
It's that movie everyone's been talking about! “Fight Spade”, right?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Yeah, and the action scenes are supposed to be really cool. I've sorta been meaning to go see it.

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Really?! Then, wanna go right now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Ah, yes, it's the trailer for it.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That movie has recently sort of become the talk of the town.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Movies...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That shoot we did ended up being an invaluable experience. Honestly, I still can't believe I got to work as an assistant to the director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I was reminded of just how deep the directing rabbit hole goes since I got to learn about different techniques and about the director's thought process.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They said the action scenes for that film are supposed to be very good... I'm curious as to how they actually shot them.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So, I think I'll go see it now.
The next screening is...
A few hours later
Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That film was much better than I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It was written as your usual good-versus-evil hero spectacle...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But the stunts and fight scenes certainly lived up to their reputation.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They even shot some scenes from a first-person perspective. It was like the viewers got to be the hero as they chased after the villain.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That kind of trick makes it much easier to understand what a character is feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But you can't really do that outside of the video medium. You need a camera to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But is there a way to achieve the same sense of immersion during a show? How would I go about doing that?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Of course, it's likely going to involve the entire audience... What else would I need to—)
Hm? Rui? Is that you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I thought it was you!
What a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, what are the odds? So, Tsukasa, what brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My mom asked me to go get some ground beef from the supermarket!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Were you also out shopping, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I was buying some things I needed for maintenance. I also decided to go see a movie before heading home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's called “Fight Spade”...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's the one Emu said she's been wanting to go see!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. She apparently saw the trailer the other day and kept exclaiming, “The space battle looked so cool! Everything went bang, zoom and sparkle-sparkle!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which made me interested too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The hero supposedly puts on an incredible performance during the action scenes, so I'd like to go see it and try learning what I can!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... I had no idea.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I guess we've all been interested in films ever since we finished doing that shoot.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'll start telling you all about any new films that catch my eye.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, if any interest all four of us, we could go see them together.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Together?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. I think we stand to gain quite a lot since we'd get to discuss and analyze them as a group.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's an excellent idea!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, I'll also let you all know about any films that catch my attention! No, we should all be doing this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: All of us...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! We should tell Nene and Emu about this idea! Where did I put my phone...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hehe. All of us, eh?)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The old me would never have imagined any of this happening.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But now, I'm doing shows with my friends...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (And even after leaving Phoenix Wonderland, we're still trying new things together.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I really can't ask for more...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In order to make my own dream come true, as well as to make them shine as brightly as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I need to keep improving as a director.)
